title: I built a material studio that turns textures into editable PBR materials
author: Frosty_Trainer_8490
selftext:
Most texture workflows seem to end once the maps are generated.

I've been experimenting with a different approach in PLAYTEX AI where the material stays editable after generation.

The goal is:

Texture → Maps → Material Editing → Export

rather than:

Texture → Maps → Export

Instead of just generating PBR maps and exporting them, the material remains editable.

You can:

* Generate Normal, Roughness, AO, Height, Metallic and Emissive maps
* Add cracks
* Add damage
* Add wear
* Add dirt and surface variation
* Preview changes live
* Create and save versions for future editing

Quick demo:

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=avarm4RcF1A](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=avarm4RcF1A)

As mentioned in the video, I am working on an entire new workflow for texture editing which will be out soon. A few things I haven't seen done before.

Feedback welcome.
